headlines.title: 美国7月CPI速评
headlines.summary: 美国7月CPI同比增长3.4%，符合预期，前值为增长3.5%；美国7月核心CPI同比增长2.5%，追平2021年3月以来最低增速，且符合预期，前值为增长2.6%。数据显示美国7月基本通胀表现温和，或可缓解美联储加息的压力。这份报告显示，伊朗冲突引发的能源价格冲击影响在7月继续消退。这些数据可能给美联储更多空间，在考虑是否于9月15日至16日会议上提高借贷成本时，权衡通胀压力与近期招聘放缓之间的关系。在9月会议前，决策者还将看到更多就业和通胀报告。投资者也将密切关注美联储主席凯文·沃什预计本月晚些时候在央行年度杰克逊霍尔研讨会上的讲话。

headlines.title_en: Quick read on US July CPI
headlines.summary_en: US July CPI rose 3.4% year on year, in line with expectations, versus 3.5% prior; US July core CPI rose 2.5% year on year, matching the lowest since March 2021 and in line with expectations, versus 2.6% prior. Data show US July underlying inflation was mild, which may ease pressure on Fed rate hikes. The report shows energy price shocks from the Iran conflict continued to fade in July. These data may give the Fed more room to weigh inflation pressures against recent hiring slowdown when considering whether to raise borrowing costs at its September 15-16 meeting. Policymakers will also see more jobs and inflation reports before the September meeting. Investors will also closely watch Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech expected later this month at the central bank's annual Jackson Hole symposium.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary_zh: 据仲量联行数据，香港商业地产投资第二季度增长逾一倍，达到31亿美元，零售和写字楼交易强劲增长及低基数效应使其成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场。同比增长129%，超过了新加坡等其他表现最佳的市场。

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title_zh: 在香港零售物业市场疲软之际，麦当劳的资产有何独特优势？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自有香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近一半物业找到买家，尽管香港零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该物业组合最初估值约为30亿港元（合3亿美元）。

headlines.title: 中国主动量化策略首度嵌入境外主动ETF
headlines.summary: 富国基金旗下全资子公司富国香港获银河国际证券（新加坡）有限公司委任为投资顾问，为一只聚焦新加坡本地中小市值股票的主动管理型权益ETF提供选股支持。据悉，该产品已启动发行，预计9月3日在新加坡交易所主板挂牌。近年来，公募“出海”持续升级。在境外机构设置方面，公募境外子公司已超30家，遍布新加坡、北美等地区；产品层面，互联互通发展如火如荼，互挂ETF相继落地，并联合境外多家资管机构发行基金产品，吸引海外资金投资A股。（中国基金报）

headlines.title_en: China's active quant strategy debuts in offshore active ETF
headlines.summary_en: Fullgoal Fund's wholly owned subsidiary Fullgoal Hong Kong has been appointed as investment adviser by Galaxy International Securities (Singapore) to provide stock selection support for an actively managed equity ETF focused on Singapore-listed small and mid-cap stocks. The product has launched and is expected to list on the Singapore Exchange mainboard on September 3. In recent years, public fund 'going global' has continued to upgrade. On overseas entity setup, over 30 overseas subsidiaries of public funds are now spread across Singapore, North America, and other regions; on the product front, cross-border connectivity is thriving, with mutual-listed ETFs launching successively and fund products jointly issued with multiple overseas asset managers to attract overseas capital into A-shares. (中国基金报)

headlines.title: 荣耀CEO李健：未来2~3年将迎来AI终端设备大爆发
headlines.summary: 荣耀CEO李健在接受采访时表示，“整个消费电子行业，甚至可能以外与内存存在强相关的行业，实际上都面临着极大的压力，全球的市场空间是在压缩的。但另外一方面也有机会，未来2~3年一定是AI终端设备大爆发的时间，我跟团队对此都特别有信心，两三年后再回过头来看，行业会发生变化。”（科创板日报）

headlines.title_en: Honor CEO Li Jian: AI terminal devices to see explosive growth in next 2-3 years
headlines.summary_en: Honor CEO Li Jian said in an interview, "The entire consumer electronics industry, and even industries strongly correlated with memory, are actually under tremendous pressure, with global market space shrinking. But on the other hand, there are opportunities; the next 2-3 years will surely be a boom period for AI terminal devices. I and the team are very confident about this. Looking back two to three years from now, the industry will have changed." (科创板日报)

headlines.title: 中国贸促会副会长林红红会见美国苹果公司大中华区政府事务总经理范勇
headlines.summary: 8月12日，中国贸促会副会长林红红在京会见美国苹果公司大中华区政府事务总经理范勇一行。双方围绕促进外资企业更好在华发展、参与2026年APEC系列工商界活动、加强产业链供应链合作等议题进行交流。

headlines.title_en: Lin Honghong, Vice Chair of CCPIT, meets Fan Yong, GM of Apple's Greater China Government Affairs
headlines.summary_en: On August 12, CCPIT Vice President Lin Honghong met with Apple's Greater China Government Affairs General Manager Fan Yong in Beijing. The two sides exchanged views on topics including facilitating better development of foreign enterprises in China, participating in 2026 APEC business activities, and strengthening industrial chain and supply chain cooperation.
